component_rules: Keep XianyuDispatchBackfillDialog cohesive at the single channel-order use site.
Do not extract a shared backfill hook or form unless a second production surface needs the same state machine.
Reuse XianyuOrderShipService aggregate helpers only where ship and backfill invariants match; never route backfill through the remote-write method.
If multi-item allocation is introduced later, extract an explicit order-item selection policy in a separate approved change.
